purpose: Descriptive held-out-record risk on a released conjoint file, separate from empirical-projection error and known-truth simulations
allocation_algorithm: numpy.random.RandomState; permutation of 240 consecutive five-row source-convention blocks; nested first m labelled rows
nuisance: Unchanged manuscript five-fold ridge routine; C=0.05; no holdout outcomes or features used for prediction fitting or power tuning
power: Unchanged manuscript pooled-information covariance trace rule, at human ridge start, truncated to [0,1]
Firth: Unchanged independent implementation; three starts; smallest penalized objective among verified positive-Hessian roots; no global certificate
primary_metric: mean held-out human negative log likelihood
summaries: All allocations and statuses; risk conditional on available fits; paired differences against human ridge on shared finite fits, with random-allocation MCSE only; unit-PPI-with-ridge-fallback risk retained separately
evaluation_caveat: The numeric file releases X,y,y_aug only. Respondent IDs are absent. Nonoverlapping row positions do not certify nonoverlapping people or independence. Prefix/suffix covariate or selection differences are possible.
preflight_already_seen: File keys/shapes, full-rank contrast matrices, prefix/suffix outcome fractions and hard-AI accuracy; no held-out fitted-model result had been computed for this follow-up
